description: A stored VAT return receipt by its file name, over the deployed API: what HMRC answered when it accepted the return (the processing date, the form bundle number, the payment indicator and the charge reference). clientId, when given, narrows the fetch to one of the practice's clients but does not change which receipt is read.

clientId.description: A practice client's id, to check the receipt belongs to that client

name.description: The receipt file name, including .json (submit_vat_return answers receiptId without the suffix)

name: get_vat_receipt
title: Get a VAT receipt
